question: What materials for vessels are enumerated in response to the goddess?
premises: Vessels made of clay are included
Vessels born of tortoise are included
Vessels made of bell-metal and copper-metal are included
inference: Acceptable vessels include those made of clay, tortoise, bell-metal, and copper-metal
uncertainties: kūrmajaṃ may refer to a tortoise-shell vessel or another tortoise-derived material
plain_english: O goddess, vessels made of clay, born of tortoise, made of bell-metal, and born of copper-metal.
